name: Três Tentos Agroindustrial S/A
summary: Três Tentos Agroindustrial S/A operates as a significant enterprise within the agricultural sector, providing a wide range of farm essentials including seeds, fertilizers, and crop protection chemicals. The company also processes soybeans into animal feed ingredients and biodiesel, in addition to trading various grains. Its service offerings extend to comprehensive support solutions such as expert technical guidance, integrated digital platforms, and advanced digital tools that facilitate grain transactions, monitoring, and tailored agronomic recommendations. Founded in 1954, the firm's headquarters are located in Santa Bárbara do Sul, Brazil.
